# Visit Greater Palm Springs

> The official travel guide to Greater Palm Springs offering comprehensive resources for weddings, accommodations, dining, attractions, events, and travel planning.

Visit Greater Palm Springs is the destination marketing organization for the Greater Palm Springs region, serving both leisure travelers and tourism professionals. The site provides curated information about the region's world-class wedding venues, hospitality options, attractions, and travel logistics.

## Key Topics

- Greater Palm Springs
- Palm Springs
- Destination Weddings
- Wedding Venues
- Travel Guide

- Restaurants & Dining

- Travel Trade

- Rancho Mirage
- Palm Desert
- Indian Wells
- Joshua Tree National Park
- Palm Springs International Airport

## Wedding Planning & Venues

- [Weddings in Greater Palm Springs | Perfect Wedding Venues!](https://www.visitgreaterpalmsprings.com/weddings): Wedding planning hub for Greater Palm Springs venues, vendors, and services.
- [Find the Perfect Wedding Venues in Greater Palm Springs](https://www.visitgreaterpalmsprings.com/weddings/venues): Comprehensive guide to wedding venues in Greater Palm Springs region.
- [Iconic and Unique Homes for Weddings in Greater Palm Springs](https://www.visitgreaterpalmsprings.com/weddings/venues/iconic-and-unique-homes): Guide to iconic estates and unique homes for Palm Springs weddings.
- [Spectacular Wedding Venues in Greater Palm Springs](https://www.visitgreaterpalmsprings.com/weddings/venues/unique-venues): Curated list of spectacular wedding venues across Greater Palm Springs.
- [Expert Tips for Planning a Wedding in Greater Palm Springs](https://www.visitgreaterpalmsprings.com/weddings/wedding-vendor-and-services): Expert wedding planning tips and vendor services for Palm Springs weddings.
- [Plan Your Wedding in Greater Palm Springs - We Can Help](https://www.visitgreaterpalmsprings.com/weddings/let-us-help): Wedding planning assistance and service provider directory for Palm Springs.
- [Plan the Ultimate Bachelorette Party in Greater Palm Springs](https://www.visitgreaterpalmsprings.com/weddings/bachelorette-parties): Planning guide for bachelorette parties in Greater Palm Springs.

## Travel Planning & Transportation
